o.text: From Old Anatolian Turkish [script needed] (erken, “early, early in the morning”), from [script needed] (er, “early”) and [script needed] (iken), equivalent to modern Azerbaijani -kən. Compare Turkish erken. Ultimately a derivation from Proto-Turkic *ẹ̄r (“early”).
From proqram (“program”) + təminatı (“provisions”). Calque of Russian програ́ммное обеспече́ние (prográmmnoje obespečénije).

From səhnə + -ləş + -dir.
Compare Turkmen sahnalaşdyrmak, Uyghur سەھنىلەشتۈرمەك (sehnileshtürmek), Uzbek sahnalashtirmoq.
